purpose: Define each machine-significant DWH quality rule as an explicit canonical identity bound to exact schema/field/resource targets and deterministic evaluation semantics.

owns: DWH Data Quality Rule Identity semantics

topics.name: DWH Data Quality Rule Identity
topics.purpose: Define each machine-significant DWH quality rule as an explicit canonical identity bound to exact schema/field/resource targets and deterministic evaluation semantics.

semantics.identity_rule: Every quality rule has an explicit stable canonical identity.
semantics.target_rule: Rule targets exact schema, field, relation, record type or declared resource identities.
semantics.semantics_rule: Evaluation predicate/profile and pass/fail/unknown semantics are explicit.
semantics.version_rule: Rule version/profile is explicit where changes affect interpretation.
semantics.ownership_rule: Quality rule does not take ownership of the data it evaluates.
semantics.authority_rule: Rule pass/fail is not an AccessCore authorization decision.
semantics.mutation_rule: Rule evaluation is read-only unless a separate remediation operation is invoked.

invariants.rule: Data-quality rules and results produce explicit evidence about exact data/schema identities; they never silently rewrite source data, change semantic ownership, declassify content or become authorization decisions.

hard_gates.condition: quality rule target inferred by display label
rule semantics change without version/profile evidence

references.purpose: Quality rules bind exact schema/field identities.
